about.tagline: Find, preview and manage your Word, Excel and PDF documents on this computer.
about.what: The app scans the drives or folders you choose for .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx and .pdf files, keeps a list of them in a database on this computer, and lets you search, preview, open, rename and delete them. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
about.s1: Press Scan to find documents (all drives, or choose a folder with Folder…). The list is saved, so you do not need to scan every time.
about.s2: Type in the search box to find files by name. Use the type buttons (doc, docx, xls, xlsx, pdf) to filter.
about.s3: To search inside documents, press Index contents once (it runs in the background and notifies you when it finishes), then switch the search to Contents.
about.s4: Click a file and turn on Quick view (the eye button) to preview it. Use the up/down arrows to move between files. Double-click or press Enter to open a file.
about.s5: The Folders view shows a tree with the number of files and the total size of each folder.
about.s6: Right-click a file for more actions: show in folder, copy the path, rename (F2), move to trash. Select several files with the checkboxes, Ctrl/Shift-click or Ctrl+A.
about.s7: Deleting always moves files to the Trash / Recycle Bin, so you can restore them.
about.s8: In Settings you can change the language and theme, choose which system folders to include, set up automatic scans and the system tray.
about.l1: Scanned documents cannot be searched by content. A PDF that is only a picture of a page (a scan or a photo) has no text for the app to read, and there is no OCR (text recognition) yet. Such files are still listed and can be found by name.
about.l2: Georgian text must be real Unicode to be searchable. Documents (Word, Excel, PDF) written with old non-Unicode Georgian fonts, such as AcadNusx or LitNusx, look correct on screen, but the text inside is stored as Latin letters. Searching in Georgian will not find it, and Quick view may show meaningless characters. Documents made with Unicode fonts (for example Sylfaen, Segoe UI or Noto Sans Georgian) work normally.
about.l3: Very large files are skipped when indexing contents (you can change the limit in Settings). Quick view shows only the first part of long documents.
about.l4: Old .doc files are shown as plain text in Quick view.
